description.en: Locks the message window, preventing the player from advancing/dismissing it (e.g. while other scripted action needs to finish first).
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Prevent the player from dismissing the message window
CMND_MESWIN_LOCK();
